description: Every devDependency update in one PR: no matchUpdateTypes, so majors and the pins :pinDevDependencies introduces land in the same branch as the minors and patches.

Last among the rules that can set a group, so it wins over the monorepo and grouping presets config:recommended brings in — those would otherwise pull eslint, prettier and typescript-eslint into groups of their own.
groupSlug is spelled out rather than derived, because a groupName inherited from one of those presets would name the branch even when this rule sets its own.
